caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a dark brown frame and a distinctive, intricate backrest design featuring looping curves and carved details that form a heart-like shape with vertical and radiating elements in the center. The chair has two gently curved arms, each attached to the middle of the backrest and the top of the front legs. The seat of the chair is upholstered in a light-colored fabric with a pattern that includes soft pink, beige, and muted green tones, showing a pastoral scene with a small figure and landscape elements. The chair stands on four straight tapered legs, each with subtle carving details near the top and bottom. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and a faint border frame surrounds the image. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Armchair
